scope: archived exploratory evidence; no v4 selection/test result; no new simulations
warnings: Own W1 is a population distribution metric before copy, not selected-member truth accuracy.
Duffing examples compare complete policies including different donor assignment/selection; they do not isolate replay causality.
Pilot A and B differ in cohort, origin and repair policy; they are illustrative, not independent repetitions of one intervention.
Spread loss uses archived per-interval spread/reference, not v4 base-window loss.
Historical paired dCRPS compares updated and frozen pre-update ensemble continuations, not full-run no correction.
Confidence intervals are archived segment-bootstrap intervals, not seed-bank or physical-replicate confidence intervals.
Two validation starts within a system are not independent physical replicates.
Failure detection accuracy, pure member restoration and mediation through diversity are not established by these summaries.
